free_tier.stated: models whose id ends in :free cost $0.00; limits are 5 requests per minute and 200 requests per day on the rate-limits page, and 20 requests per minute and 200 requests per day on the FAQ page, so the two pages disagree on the per-minute figure
free_tier.notes: the FAQ calls the limits hard caps with no way to increase them; paid models need a positive account balance

tooling: any OpenAI-compatible client at https://api.routeway.ai/v1; Anthropic-style /v1/messages for models that expose it
chaining: a free :free model set behind one key, usable as a low-priority overflow lane next to the other gateways

limits.value: rate-limits page: 5 requests per minute and 200 requests per day on :free models; FAQ page: 20 requests per minute and 200 requests per day; the daily figure agrees and resets at 00:00 UTC

identity_cost.detail: the vendor lists 'a valid email address and payment method' among account-creation requirements; whether the dashboard enforces a payment method before issuing a key for :free models was not observed

reliability_note: free models run in a lower-priority routing queue with more 502 upstream errors and can be removed at any time
confidence_note: limits and the queue statement are quoted from the vendor's docs; the two docs pages disagree on the per-minute figure and the sign-up enforcement was not observed.

evidence.proved: rate-limits page gives 5 requests per minute for :free models
rate-limits page gives 200 requests per day for :free models
